sources.title: OrderModel Architecture | microsoft/MarS | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document provides a detailed technical overview of the OrderModel architecture, the core machine learning component of the MarS system. The OrderModel is a transformer-based neural network designed to generate realistic market orders by learning from historical order patterns.

sources.title: AI Model Catalog | Microsoft Foundry Models
sources.snippet: MARS uses an autoregressive transformer architecture built on the HuggingFace ecosystem. The model processes satellite or aerial imagery tiles and outputs GeoJSON geometries (polygons for buildings and waterbodies, polylines for roads/railways) with category labels and confidence scores.
